title: Portable Web Toolkit — Local Agent Environment
subtitle: Scans for missing/outdated tools, then installs the agent baseline in one step.
adminNote: Coding agents should run setup with --yes. sudo (macOS/Linux) or UAC (Windows) will prompt the user for a password when elevation is required — the user should not need to manually launch scripts.

required.name: Core host tools
required.description: Git, Node.js 26+, pyenv-native (pyenv) + pyenv-gui, Python workspace venv, pip — Node is installed by bootstrap when missing

workspace.name: Project folder checks
workspace.description: Verify README, package.json, Astro config, and related files in the target workspace

confirmPrompt: The following software is not installed or is outdated. Press Y to continue setting up the local agent environment
pyenvNativeBlurb: Python is managed exclusively by pyenv-native: the `pyenv` CLI plus the pyenv-gui desktop companion (launch with `pyenv gui`). Do not install system/winget/Homebrew Python for toolkit work.
